notes.title: Deserter - conceptual sequel to the tactical stealth game Gone Rogue
notes.content:
Welcome to the page of our new stealth game, Deserter!

In this game, we aim to bring to life everything we couldn’t implement in our first game, Gone Rogue. We also strive to incorporate most of our players' feedback and suggestions. The game will take place in the familiar universe of a dark dystopia and the oppression of the all-powerful totalitarian State, but with a new plot and characters (you don’t need to play Gone Rogue to understand the story of Deserter).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313160/d4588320aec7ae452629bb9a4105daf497b35386.png
Compared to the first installment, the game will feature numerous innovations:

 New break-in methods, new gadgets, and new enemies
 Exploration in a semi-open world instead of separate missions
 Increased immersion
 Survival elements
 Character control via keyboard or gamepad
 Enhanced graphics, enemy AI, storyline, sound, and music

We plan to regularly share updates about these and other new features, so subscribe to our news by clicking the “Follow” button.
